gaps: eastern_mi_8_hip_mi_8amtsh: no top view; the head-on is a grey Mi-8 variant (same nose)

eastern_mi_8_hip_mi_8amtsh: dimensions 18.17 x 5.6 x 4.76 m: length and height against Vertipedia's Mi-8AMT (https://vertipedia.vtol.org/aircraft/getAircraft/aircraftID/521: airframe 18.22 x - x 4.75): within 0.3%. Width over the AMTSh's six-station outriggers has no published figure: Vertipedia gives 2.50 m for the bare Mi-8 (https://vertipedia.vtol.org/aircraft/getAircraft/aircraftID/117), 4.50 m for the Mi-8T/MT with the older outriggers (https://vertipedia.vtol.org/aircraft/getAircraft/aircraftID/378) and 7.20 m for its Mi-17 entry (https://vertipedia.vtol.org/aircraft/getAircraft/aircraftID/168); 5.6 m is measured off the front photo
